latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of analytics-sdk-setup skill for TikTok and Meta Pixel repo integration:

- Provides a detailed workflow for auditing, installing, reconciling, or fixing TikTok and Meta Pixel code in codebases.
- Introduces mandatory execution mode selection (Direct implementation, Plan first, Questions first) before any code changes, with explicit mode output and justification.
- Emphasizes privacy/compliance gating, duplicate initialization, cross-platform consistency, ownership/source-of-truth, and governance.
- Outlines quick fix mode for narrow, well-scoped requests.
- Includes clear activation/deactivation criteria and step-by-step agent thinking process.
- Targets repo-aware coding agents for direct code inspection and repair.
